Actual frames380/386: same30 symbols remain near own positions; orange emphasis guide advances right independently. Frozen formula limits each displacement to±8px, no mass flow across the gap. Regular rows/guide are schematic, not literal molecular trajectories or a calibrated pressure front.
Actual frames1040/1046: cyan wave and forward signal connect radios across the vacuum, with no orange medium; marker/phase advance right.

Actual frames1190/1196 plus shot09: labeled receiver→speaker→20 local air-particle symbols→ear, confined to closed internal-helmet cutaway. Local air shifts near its own positions, no air in exterior vacuum. Ear cue remains audible-sound explanation.
Contact spans all ten cue midpoints; mechanism labels, schematic note and Traditional Chinese subtitles remain aligned. No new critical problem observed after encoding.
